next.reason: 1985 REWRITE GR1: the file 'must be a mass storage file and must be open in the I-O mode'. §2023:14.9.35.4 GR3 'The rewrite file connector shall have an open mode of I-O' ('49' otherwise, as 1985 status 49; §2023:9.1.13.7 GR9), the connector being that of record-name-1's file (§2023:14.9.35.4 GR2). The mass-storage part is kept: §2023:14.9.35.1 'The REWRITE statement logically replaces a record existing in a mass storage file', and §2023:14.9.27.4 GR16 lets only a file supporting the I-O-mode statements (REWRITE included) be opened I-O, as 1985 OPEN GR17 did. A conforming 1985 REWRITE behaves the same.
